summary: Seller Company Workspace testing complete. All critical bugs fixed and verified: (1) company_id persists to document root (not inside seller_overrides), (2) by-company lookup finds profile after company_id linked, (3) panel status updates and readiness recalculation work, (4) pricing persistence works with comfort_floor calculation, (5) rehidratación preserves all data after navigation. Backend: 21/21 tests passed. Frontend: All panels load correctly, GUARDAR saves data, success message displays.

minor.issue: Returns 422 when financials have CIS nested format (pnl/balance structure). Frontend catches error silently.

integration_issues.issue: CALCULAR VALORACIÓN button enabled but valuation fails because financials from CIS are not synced to company collection (format mismatch). Financials display correctly from seller_profile but company.financials is empty.

backend: POST /api/seller-profiles/resolve-and-save - resolves CIF via CIS, creates/updates profile
POST /api/seller-profiles/resolve-and-save - idempotent (same CIF returns same profile)
PUT /api/seller-profiles/{id}/overrides - CRITICAL: company_id persists to document root
PUT /api/seller-profiles/{id}/panel-status - updates status and recalculates readiness
PUT /api/seller-profiles/{id}/pricing - define_price strategy with comfort_floor calculation
frontend: Workspace loads with correct company name in sidebar
Panel Compañía - CIF input, VERIFICAR button, success feedback, company data display
Panel Compañía - Coverage badges (IDENTITY, FINANCIALS, BALANCE, EMPLOYEES, ENRICHMENT)
Panel Ficha - taxonomy dropdowns editable, qualitative signals
Panel Financieros - financial data from CIS displayed with source label
Panel Valoración - CALCULAR VALORACIÓN button present
Panel Operación - operation types selectable/deselectable, pricing strategy, motivation field
GUARDAR button - saves data, shows 'Guardado correctamente' message
Panel status dots - turn green when panel is complete
Readiness percentage - updates correctly (80% with 4/5 panels complete)
Rehidratación - navigate away and back, all data preserved

action_items: MINOR: Fix financials sync from seller_profile to company collection - CIS format (pnl/balance nested) needs to be transformed to flat format expected by companies API. This blocks valuation calculation from workspace.
critical_code_review_comments: Line 213 in SellerCompanyWorkspace.js: companiesAPI.updateFinancials fails silently with .catch(() => {}). Consider logging error or showing user feedback.
Financials format mismatch: CIS returns {year, pnl: {revenue, ebitda...}, balance: {...}} but companies API expects {year, revenue, ebitda...} flat structure.
